source_books: دليل المعلم لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الثالث الفصل الأول (g3-english-s1-teachers-book, Jordan Team Together series, Pearson/York Press)
meta.provenance_note: No Grade 3 Semester 1 pupil's book was supplied — only the Teacher's Book and Activity Book. Read directly from the Teacher's Book PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-18. Following g5EnglishSem1's precedent for a missing/unreliable per-lesson breakdown, unit titles, vocabulary, grammar structures (with the book's own example sentences), and skill descriptors were taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 2-3 of the Teacher's Book), cross-checked row-by-row against each unit's own Unit walkthrough spread (pp. 8-12) for thematic consistency — the table's two half-pages (Vocabulary/Grammar/Listening/Speaking on one page, Reading/Writing/Phonics/Project/Functions on the facing page) extract in two separate blocks via PyMuPDF's column order, not interleaved by row, so each unit's identity across the two blocks was verified by topic match (e.g. 'Let's dress up!' pairs with the clothes/price row on both pages), not position alone. The Teacher's Book itself states each main unit has 12 lessons (component/focus table, p.3), but the per-lesson breakdown (Lesson 1, Lesson 2...) was not reconstructed — same two-lessons-per-unit shape as g5EnglishSem1: Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking.
known_gaps: This is real content (vocabulary lists, grammar points with the book's own example sentences, skill descriptors), not title-only — but it is unit-level, not lesson-level, same as g5EnglishSem1: each unit's actual 12 internal lessons and their exact titles were not verified page by page.

Following the g5EnglishSem1/g7EngSem1 precedent for English-subject books, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

Phonics word lists (e.g. 'pl, bl: play, plane, plum, plug...') are printed inside the same table cell as Vocabulary but are sound-pattern examples, not topical vocabulary — excluded from `vocabulary` here, same exclusion category as g5EnglishSem1's supplementary sections.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): the Welcome unit (alphabet/greetings, precedes Unit 1's own row), 'Atomic's Learning Club: Language booster', the Festivals section (Months and seasons, Calgary Stampede, Independence Day), and the Reading/Writing/Phonics/Project/Viewing-and-presenting/Functions columns of the scope-and-sequence table (present in the source but not carried into this schema, same scope as g5EnglishSem1).

lessons.main_idea_ar: Demonstrative pronouns — singular/plural. Examples: This is a pen./These are pens. That is a pen./Those are pens.
objectives: Demonstrative pronouns (singular/plural) — e.g. This is a pen./These are pens. That is a pen./Those are pens.

lessons.main_idea_ar: Understanding the letters of the alphabet by their names; understanding the main information when people introduce themselves; identifying everyday objects, people or animals; recognising familiar key words and descriptions, getting the gist of a simple song.
